activityinfo.name: ActivityInfo
activityinfo.about: ActivityInfo is a data management platform for humanitarian and development organizations to collect, manage, analyze, and report on program data.

google-drive.name: Google Drive
google-drive.about: Google Drive is a secure cloud storage and file collaboration platform that lets users store, share, organize, sync, and collaborate on files from anywhere, inc

details.description: Runs when an existing record is changed in a chosen form.
Make a file accessible via a shareable link and set access level (Viewer, Commenter, Editor).
Runs when a new record is added to a chosen form.
Make a copy of a Google Drive file into a selected folder, optionally giving it a new name.
Grant a specific user or anyone access to a Google Drive file as Viewer, Commenter, or Editor.
